cards.example_en: Cousins in Israel sent dates and photos for the holiday.
cards.example_zh: 以色列的表亲为节日寄来了椰枣和照片。

cards.example_en: An Israeli coach visited our basketball team last month.
cards.example_zh: 上个月一位以色列教练来看望了我们篮球队。

cards.example_en: Letters from Jordan arrived with photos of the desert.
cards.example_zh: 从约旦寄来的信里夹着沙漠的照片。

cards.example_en: A Jordanian guide led the group through the old city.
cards.example_zh: 一位约旦导游带领队伍穿过古城。

cards.example_en: Kenya is famous for wildlife parks.
cards.example_zh: 肯尼亚以野生动物园闻名。

cards.example_en: The Kenyan runners train at a high altitude.
cards.example_zh: 肯尼亚赛跑选手在高海拔地区训练。

cards.example_en: She watches a Korean series to practise listening.
cards.example_zh: 她看韩剧来练习听力。

cards.example_en: Kuwait is a small country on the Persian Gulf.
cards.example_zh: 科威特是波斯湾上的一个小国。

cards.example_en: The Kuwaiti students showed us photos of the sea.
cards.example_zh: 科威特学生们给我们看了海的照片。

cards.example_en: We tasted Lebanese bread at the international food fair.
cards.example_zh: 我们在国际美食节上尝了黎巴嫩面包。

cards.example_en: Lebanon has mountains close to the Mediterranean.
cards.example_zh: 黎巴嫩的山离地中海很近。

cards.example_en: Luxembourg is one of the smallest countries in Europe.
cards.example_zh: 卢森堡是欧洲最小的国家之一。

cards.example_en: A Luxembourger in the youth camp spoke four languages.
cards.example_zh: 青年营里一位卢森堡人会说四种语言。

cards.example_en: Malaysia is divided by the sea into two parts.
cards.example_zh: 马来西亚被海分成两部分。

cards.meaning_zh: 马来西亚人；马来西亚的
cards.example_en: Malaysian food mixes sweet, sour, and spicy tastes.
cards.example_zh: 马来西亚食物混合了甜、酸和辣。

cards.example_en: We tried Mexican tacos at the weekend market.
cards.example_zh: 周末集市上我们尝了墨西哥塔可。

cards.example_en: The football final was played in Mexico late last night.
cards.example_zh: 足球决赛于昨晚深夜在墨西哥举行。

cards.example_en: Myanmar was also called Burma in older books.
cards.example_zh: 旧书里缅甸也叫 Burma。

cards.example_en: Cheese from the Netherlands was served at the food fair.
cards.example_zh: 食品展上供应了来自荷兰的奶酪。

cards.example_en: My cousin in Norway sent a photo of deep winter snow.
cards.example_zh: 我在挪威的表哥寄来一张隆冬大雪的照片。

cards.example_en: The Norwegian sailor told us about the fjords.
cards.example_zh: 那位挪威水手给我们讲了峡湾。

cards.example_en: A student from Pakistan joined our class at the start of term.
cards.example_zh: 学期初，一名来自巴基斯坦的学生加入了我们班。

cards.meaning_zh: 巴基斯坦人；巴基斯坦的
cards.example_en: A Pakistani doctor works at the hospital near school.
cards.example_zh: 一位巴基斯坦医生在学校附近的医院工作。

cards.example_en: Ships cross Panama through a famous canal.
cards.example_zh: 船只经过一条著名运河穿越巴拿马。

cards.example_en: The Panamanian captain guided the ship into the canal.
cards.example_zh: 巴拿马船长把船引进了运河。

cards.example_en: Philippine islands stretch across a warm sea.
cards.example_zh: 菲律宾的岛屿散布在温暖的海上。

cards.example_en: The Philippines is a country of more than seven thousand islands.
cards.example_zh: 菲律宾是一个有七千多个岛屿的国家。

cards.example_en: My uncle in Poland sent a box of chocolates.
cards.example_zh: 我在波兰的叔叔寄来一盒巧克力。

cards.example_en: Portugal faces the Atlantic on the west of Spain.
cards.example_zh: 葡萄牙在西班牙西边，面向大西洋。

cards.meaning_zh: 葡萄牙人；葡萄牙语；葡萄牙的
cards.example_en: Portuguese is spoken in Portugal and in Brazil.
cards.example_zh: 葡萄牙和巴西都说葡萄牙语。

cards.example_en: ROK is the short name for South Korea.
cards.example_zh: ROK 是韩国的英文简称。

cards.example_en: The oranges from Spain were sweeter than ours.
cards.example_zh: 从西班牙运来的橙子比我们这儿的更甜。

cards.example_en: The Spaniard in our dorm cooks rice every Sunday.
cards.example_zh: 宿舍里的西班牙人每个星期天做米饭。

cards.example_en: Our class cooked a Spanish omelette during cooking class.
cards.example_zh: 我们班在烹饪课上做了西班牙蛋饼。

cards.example_en: My pen friend in Sweden sent photos of frozen lakes.
cards.example_zh: 我在瑞典的笔友寄来了结冰湖面的照片。

cards.example_en: Swedish furniture in the shop is simple and light.
cards.example_zh: 这家店的瑞典家具简洁轻巧。

cards.example_en: Swiss watches are sold in the shop at the airport.
cards.example_zh: 机场商店里卖瑞士手表。

cards.example_en: Chocolate brought back from Switzerland filled the tin.
cards.example_zh: 从瑞士带回来的巧克力把那个罐子装满了。

cards.example_en: We ordered Thai rice and mango for dessert.
cards.example_zh: 我们点了泰式芒果饭当甜点。

cards.example_en: Thailand is a popular place for a family holiday.
cards.example_zh: 泰国是很受欢迎的家庭度假地。

cards.example_en: A Turk in the history club described Istanbul.
cards.example_zh: 历史社里一位土耳其人介绍了伊斯坦布尔。

cards.example_en: We tried a Turkish dish at my uncle's house.
cards.example_zh: 我们在叔叔家尝了一道土耳其菜。

cards.example_en: Viet Nam, also written Vietnam, shares a border with China.
cards.example_zh: 越南（也写作 Vietnam）与中国接壤。

cards.example_en: The Vietnamese student taught us how to say hello.
cards.example_zh: 那位越南学生教我们怎么打招呼。
